property_summary: For every caller and any positive deposit, calling withdrawBalance must zero the caller's recorded balance before the external call, so a re-entrant callee observes getBalance(caller) == 0 during the callback; the mutant leaves the balance unchanged before the call, so the re-entrant observation is nonzero.
change_summary: Replace the reentrancy-safe balance zeroing line with a no-op assignment to a temporary-like value that does not zero the caller's balance before the external call.
